summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market share repurchases under an existing buyback programme announced May 20, 2025. During May 11-15, 2026, it bought 8,092 ordinary shares at average prices €21.95-€23.44 and 501,876 ADS-represented ordinary shares at $26.92-$28.48. All purchased shares will be cancelled. The buyback is conducted under EU MAR Article 5(1)(b). As a routine buyback execution, there is no premium, advisor, or special structure. The key watchpoint is ongoing capital return pace and impact on EPS.
